vb_textbox.text: There are two types of gnomes in the game, one with a pointy hat and one with a flat hat.  I found that the points seemed to go in runs. For example, the pointy one would stay high for a bit and then once the number started going down I would switch to the flat hat gnome and vice versa. Overall, the pointy one seemed to give the most mushrooms.  There were spells where both types of gnomes gave low amounts of mushrooms, here I would alternate between them until I got a decent number of mushrooms, then stick with it until the number started going down again. 9 seemed to be the highest number of mushrooms.
